newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel targets perishable cargo.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel targets perishable cargo.

text.p: International freight forwarder Kuehne & Nagel AG said on Monday it will target the perishables market as a key future business segment.

Chief executive officer Klaus-Michael Kuehne said in a speech to 200 employees of parent company Viag AG that Kuehne & Nagel's U.S. division had expanded into the perishables field with the takeover of a specialist import company.
The division would import perishable foods from Latin America, store them in its Miami frozen goods warehouse and distribute across the U.S., according to a company statement.
"We intend to make the perishables area into a main part of our product-specific business development in as many countries of the world as possible," Kuehne said.
In Latin America, the forwarder had established a separate management for the country branches which already represented a strong network.

Economic stabilisation in Argentina, Brazil and Chile and liberalisation would boost Latin American trade and transport requirements, he added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
